_description: Slider preset for the human_female body type. Used by bake_body_type.py. Values are shape-key values 0.0-1.0 applied to the Customisable Female Basemesh v2.1 before flattening.
_authored_by: initial draft from gdd-character-creation-pipeline.md §3 — refine in Phase 2 body production
source_basemesh: Models/Customisable Female Basemesh v2.1.1/customisable female basemesh v2.1.blend
notes: Default proportions are intentionally mild — the goal is a baseline silhouette that armor packs (sculpted for generic humanoid bodies) fit reasonably. The elf_variant_overrides are applied additively when baking the elf variant; the body_id stays `human_female` and the variant is suffixed in the output filename. polycount_target is in BLENDER POLYGONS (a mix of quads/tris); glTF triangulation roughly doubles this. Targeting 3500 Blender polys → ~6000-7000 triangles in the exported glb, well within gdd-art-direction.md §13.3's 3-8k tri figure budget.
